title: Does the Mixer Matter ? Paired-Seed Ablations of Tiny Bilingual Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2611.30623v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We report paired-seed architecture ablations from the development of Sophea Artemis, our in-house Greek-English model family. Every arm trains on the same 3B targets with a shared tokenizer and recipe; models range from 54M to 759M total parameters and roughly 54M to 124M active parameters. The main finding is that, at this tiny scale, stored capacity matters far more than mixer design. On a fixed held-out test, replacing the dense feed-forward blocks of a recurrent/attention hybrid with sixteen routed experts, at nearly the same approximate active parameters, lowers loss by 0.079 (Greek) and 0.112 (English) nats per target, and doubling to 32 experts lowers it by a further 0.022 and 0.031, at every paired seed. Reusing a four-layer block three times recovers about 40-44% of the gap between a shallow and an independently deep model, consistent with looped-Transformer results. translated_title: 混合器重要吗？小型双语语言模型的成对种子消融研究
translated_abstract: 我们报告了在开发 Sophea Artemis（我们的内部希腊语-英语模型系列）过程中进行的成对种子架构消融实验。每个实验分支都在相同的30亿（3B）目标上，使用共享的分词器和训练配方进行训练；模型总参数量从5400万到7.59亿不等，活跃参数约为5400万至1.24亿。主要发现是，在这种微小规模下，存储容量远比混合器设计更重要。在一个固定的保留测试集上，以几乎相同的近似活跃参数，将循环/注意力混合模型的密集前馈块替换为十六个路由专家，可使每个目标的损失降低0.079（希腊语）和0.112（英语）nat；在每个成对种子上，将专家数量加倍至32个可进一步降低0.022和0.031。将一个四层块重复使用三次，可以恢复浅层模型与独立深层模型之间差距的约40-44%，这与循环Transformer的结果一致。相比之下，在分组查询注意力（GQA）、G……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 对小型希腊语-英语双语模型的成对种子消融实验表明，在此微小规模下，存储容量（如稀疏专家数量）远比混合器（注意力机制）的设计选择更重要。
en_tdlr: Paired-seed ablations of tiny Greek-English bilingual models show that at this tiny scale, stored capacity (e.g., sparse experts) matters far more than the choice of mixer design.
